notes: FleetComm 1.2 — the helmet cam grows up. NEW ROLE: ELEMENT LEADER — watching the fleet's cams is now for Element Leaders and COMMAND (COMMAND grants the role); every operator can still STREAM their own cam, because who knows who will be ordered to share on the fly. Feeds now wear a field-feed look — faint scanlines and a slow refresh band, so it reads like a helmet cam and not a livestream (turn it off in SYS ▸ Helmet-cam scanlines if you want clean video) — and every feed carries a pulsing LIVE lamp with the streamer's callsign. The screen picker is fixed: tidy uniform thumbnails instead of a wall. Until your relay server takes the next update, the new role cannot be granted yet — COMMAND can watch, everyone can stream, and nothing else changes.
